title: lichen_l2 mislabels SCHC TX rejection (SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE) as CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION in retained RAM
description: P3, found by worker5 subagent robustness pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk. With the hahk gate active, lichen_schc_compress now returns SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE for malformed locally-originated IPv6 datagrams (app bug or forwarded packet). lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_tx.c:154 and firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c:993 route every negative lichen_link_tx return into crash_info_store(CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION, __LINE__, (uint32_t)(-ret)), stamping the retained-RAM record; next boot crash_info_check_and_clear() logs previous crash (reason=corruption). Before the gate this path was reachable only via genuine internal inconsistencies (buffer-too-small); now routine malformed-packet rejections pollute the field-debug trail with false corruption reports. No functional harm (no reboot, mutex unlocked on every path, nonce not consumed - next_tx at :189 is after compress at :134). Fix: distinguish validation rejects (SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE = malformed input, log + drop + counter) from corruption-class failures before calling crash_info_store, or narrow CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION to the specific internal-inconsistency returns; add a host test asserting a malformed TX does not stamp the crash record.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-jfzk (same finding: lichen_l2_tx.c:154 stamps CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION for every negative lichen_link_tx return; jfzk was filed from the wrxl security review and is already claimed and in progress by opencode-worker-1, including the new SCHC_ERR_INVALID_ENDPOINT case from wrxl). Releasing my claim to avoid two workers shipping conflicting fixes at the same site; my release also notes the fix must cover the bridge copy at firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c:993 - jfzk's worker please include it. Evidence in this bead's description remains valid.
